===== ENV-004 理解验证（2026-09-01 实机抽查）=====

===== 0. 准备：同名不同 host 两个 Account + Role lab_role4 =====
user	host
lab_v4	127.0.0.1
lab_v4	localhost

===== 1. Account 二元组：同名不同 host 是不同账号（权限分别挂） =====
--- socket 连 lab_v4@localhost → SELECT 成功
id	v
1	alpha
2	beta
--- TCP 连 lab_v4@127.0.0.1 → 同密码但 SELECT 被拒（无表权限）
ERROR 1044 (42000): Access denied for user 'lab_v4'@'127.0.0.1' to database 'mysql_lab_v4'

===== 2. Role 默认不激活：CURRENT_ROLE()=NONE，权限不生效 =====
--- 未 SET ROLE → CURRENT_ROLE() 与 SELECT
u	cu	cr
lab_v4@localhost	lab_v4@localhost	NONE
id	v
1	alpha
2	beta

===== 3. SET ROLE 激活后权限生效 =====
--- SET ROLE lab_role4 → SELECT 成功
u	cu	cr
lab_v4@localhost	lab_v4@localhost	`lab_role4`@`%`
id	v
1	alpha
2	beta

===== 4. 排查三连 + SHOW GRANTS（固定流程） =====
--- 三连 + grants
USER()	CURRENT_USER()	CURRENT_ROLE()
lab_v4@localhost	lab_v4@localhost	NONE
Grants for lab_v4@localhost
GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `lab_v4`@`localhost`
GRANT SELECT ON `mysql_lab_v4`.`t_v4` TO `lab_v4`@`localhost`
GRANT `lab_role4`@`%` TO `lab_v4`@`localhost`

===== 5. 清理 =====
user	host
lab_user	%
lab_user	localhost
DONE
